title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 5th August 2026 || TV5 Money

recommendations.price: near 52-week low; exit on rally at 650-680
recommendations.note: Weak but from a big group - patience needed. Not a level to sell. Exit on technical rally at 650-680.
recommendations.detail: Jyoti from Kamareddy called with a 20% loss in HDFC Life. The anchor explicitly asked Kutumba Rao garu. He said the stock is weak and near its 52-week low, but coming from a big group, patience is needed. At this level it is not a level to sell. Maybe on a technical rally, when it comes to 650 or 680, exit at that point. But presently, hold.

recommendations.price: buy near 380; could reach 500 in 6 months
recommendations.note: Green shoe selling pressure exists but LIC shifting to equities in portfolio. Could reach 500 in next 6 months.
recommendations.detail: In his market commentary section, Kutumba Rao noted that the government is exercising the green shoe option in LIC, so selling pressure continues. He said to buy when it comes close to 380. LIC is reducing debt lending and putting more money into equities. If equity markets rise and LIC's portfolio improves, the view could change dramatically. He said he would not be surprised if it reaches the 500 level at some point in the next six months, though it is not a very outperforming stock.
